home.body_sample: Hair Skin Wellness. Ask SpoiledBrain. Not sure what you need? Let SpoiledBrain find your perfect hair and skin products. Popular Searches: Anti-Aging, Hair Loss, Collagen, Wrinkles, Hair Growth, Damaged Hair, Brittle Nails. Find exactly what you need - SpoiledBrain will identify the exact products for you based on your needs. THE FUTURE OF WELLNESS. Intelligent skin and hair products that refuse to take aging seriously. A complete spectrum of best in class products for personalized age-control. Note: spoiledchild.com redirected to spoiledchild.co.uk during collection; SKU naming is alphanumeric (E27, A22, S33+) across skin, hair and wellness.
home.fit: **Skincare at brand level, ingestible at ad level — the gap matters.** The topical line is real (S33+ Collagen Burst Serum, T31 Vitamin C Eye Cream, O36+ Triple-Peptide Moisturizer), which is why it stays tagged `skincare`. But Agent 2 found 27 of its 29 mined ads running ingestible liquid collagen, appetite suppression and hair thinning, with only two topical eye ads. Whatever we write has to sell the topical line, not follow where their spend actually goes.
